note: parseInt keeps the figures the written quantity begins with and passes over the rest, so a docket that says anything but a plain figure is drawn on instead of being set aside
the carts are read back off the keys of an object, and a key that reads as a whole number comes back in counting order rather than in the order the cart first loaded
a spell is only closed where the next burner takes the kiln over, so the last spell of the day never reaches the list at all
